outcome: Elastic properties (shear modulus in kilopascals) of the levator ani muscles
cohort: Twelve parous nonpregnant women with a mean age of 31 years, mean BMI of 28 kg/m^2, and a mean of 14 months since their last delivery.
finding: Assessment of the elastic properties of the levator ani muscles using shear wave elastography is feasible in nonpregnant women, showing a more than twofold increase in shear modulus from rest to Valsalva maneuver.
cross-section timing: Measurements taken at rest and during Valsalva maneuver in nonpregnant parous women.
